findings.candidateQuote: 143 boxes sitting next to a dead machine
findings.explanation: A "silent" (idle) printer becomes a "dead" one, asserting a malfunction that the case study later rules out.
findings.sourceQuote: 143 boxes waiting beside a silent machine

findings.candidateQuote: By noon, the main problem was obvious.
findings.explanation: The temporal marker shifts from lunch to the specific clock time noon, which is a load-bearing deadline elsewhere in this text.
findings.sourceQuote: By lunch, the primary problem was plain.

findings.candidateQuote: a cheaper and more precise answer
findings.explanation: In a measurement context "accurate" and "precise" are distinct properties, so the closing claim about the answer is changed.
findings.sourceQuote: a cheaper and more accurate answer

findings.candidateQuote: 11:00, scoring review.
findings.explanation: The notebook entry label is changed from a review of handling to a review of scoring, which is not a synonym.
findings.sourceQuote: 11:00, handling review.

findings.candidateQuote: An automated update could mention
findings.explanation: "Synthetic" (fabricated, consistent with the fictional framing) is replaced by "automated" (machine-generated), a different property of the update.
findings.sourceQuote: A synthetic update could mention

findings.candidateQuote: The label resting beside the scale read
findings.explanation: A written note is recast as a label, changing the identity of the object bearing the quoted instruction.
findings.sourceQuote: The note beside the scale read

findings.candidateQuote: confirms the fuel level, radio power, and the passenger count
findings.explanation: The pre-departure checklist item changes from a piece of equipment (the passenger counter) to a data value (the passenger count), which is a different object of inspection forty minutes before boarding.
findings.sourceQuote: verify fuel, radio power, and the passenger counter

findings.candidateQuote: These notes have been edited and come from a fictional interview.
findings.explanation: The source's title heading is absent from the candidate, which opens directly with the body text.
findings.sourceQuote: # Notes from an Interview About the Night Ferry

findings.candidateQuote: Synthetic campaign tags comprised @brindle_market and #quiet-pickup.
findings.explanation: "Included" leaves the tag list open-ended while "comprised" makes it exhaustive, narrowing the stated scope.
findings.sourceQuote: Synthetic campaign tags included @brindle_market and #quiet-pickup.

findings.candidateQuote: Their matching result indicated that the clock rule was correct
findings.explanation: Certainty is raised from a tentative suggestion to a positive indication of the evidence.
findings.sourceQuote: Their matching result suggested that the clock rule was correct

findings.candidateQuote: Success demands a clear definition.
findings.explanation: The required property of the definition shifts from accuracy to clarity, two properties the source itself treats as distinct elsewhere ("clear and accurate").
findings.sourceQuote: Success needs an accurate definition.

findings.candidateQuote: Multiple containers bore a room number yet lacked no priority marking.
findings.explanation: The double negative "lacked no priority marking" reverses the source's claim that the boxes had no priority label, contradicting the rest of the paragraph.
findings.sourceQuote: Several boxes had a room number but no priority label.

findings.candidateQuote: examined the documentation in the unobstructed meeting room
findings.explanation: "Dry" (relevant to a flood drill) is replaced by "unobstructed" (not blocked), a different property of the room.
findings.sourceQuote: reviewed the record in the dry meeting room

findings.candidateQuote: not the logistical relocation itself
findings.explanation: The source contrasts authorization uncertainty with the physical act of moving boxes, while the candidate contrasts it with a logistical relocation, blurring the physical-versus-organizational distinction.
findings.sourceQuote: not the physical move itself

findings.candidateQuote: essential records, duplicable copies, and materials
findings.explanation: The category "replaceable copies" (can be replaced if lost) becomes "duplicable copies" (can be copied), changing what the triage category means.
findings.sourceQuote: vital records, replaceable copies, and supplies

findings.candidateQuote: 143 parcels sitting idle beside an unresponsive device
findings.explanation: "Silent" describes a machine that is merely idle, while "unresponsive" asserts a malfunctioning device, which conflicts with the article's later claim that printer speed was never the issue.
findings.sourceQuote: 143 boxes waiting beside a silent machine

findings.candidateQuote: start maintaining a written log
findings.explanation: The specific physical medium (paper), which the piece contrasts with the laptop counter and screens, is generalized to "written", which could equally be a digital document.
findings.sourceQuote: start a paper log

findings.candidateQuote: it cannot inform me about internal stress
findings.explanation: Strain (deformation) is swapped for stress (internal force), which is a different material property, not a synonym.
findings.sourceQuote: it cannot tell me about internal strain

findings.candidateQuote: log weight on one scale
findings.explanation: In a materials lab notebook mass and weight are distinct quantities, and the same swap recurs in the final mass-loss result.
findings.sourceQuote: record mass on a single scale

findings.candidateQuote: The covered tiles remained flawless and uniform.
findings.explanation: A hedged statement about appearance becomes an unhedged assertion that the tiles actually had no flaws.
findings.sourceQuote: The covered tiles still looked unmarked and even.

findings.candidateQuote: Proof that the metric was accurate would require additional observers
findings.explanation: The evidentiary standard is escalated from evidence to proof.
findings.sourceQuote: Evidence that the measure was correct would require more observers

findings.candidateQuote: fix the crack criterion before inspecting any tile
findings.explanation: The pre-registration boundary is loosened from before any visual exposure to the tiles to merely before formally inspecting them.
findings.sourceQuote: select the crack rule before seeing any tile

findings.candidateQuote: Sea spray and damp hands make touchscreens undependable.
findings.explanation: The source blames wet gloves (equipment worn by the crew) for screen unreliability, while the candidate substitutes damp hands, a different physical entity and a different failure mechanism.
findings.sourceQuote: Salt spray and wet gloves leave screens unreliable.

findings.candidateQuote: The adjusted routine added about three minutes to a typical sailing time.
findings.explanation: The three minutes is attached to the departure procedure in the source but to the sailing time (voyage duration) in the candidate.
findings.sourceQuote: The revised sequence added about three minutes to a usual departure.

findings.candidateQuote: A tool that removes one mistake while creating a significant boarding delay may not help things overall.
findings.explanation: "Reduces one error" is weakened partial improvement, whereas "removes one mistake" claims complete elimination.
findings.sourceQuote: A tool that reduces one error while adding a big boarding delay may not improve matters.

findings.candidateQuote: Conditions, upkeep, and the judgment of the crew all remain relevant.
findings.explanation: The specific factor "weather" is generalized to the vague "conditions", dropping the named consideration.
findings.sourceQuote: Weather, maintenance, and crew judgment still matter.

findings.candidateQuote: Tomas provided the perspective of a seasoned operator, not a quantified study.
findings.explanation: The caveat contrasts the account with a measured comparison in the source but with a quantified study in the candidate, changing what the account is said to lack.
findings.sourceQuote: Tomas gave an experienced operator's account, not a measured comparison.

findings.candidateQuote: That difference matters a great deal whenever a manager looks into a delayed sailing.
findings.explanation: "Is important" is intensified to "matters a great deal", raising the stated weight of the distinction.
findings.sourceQuote: That distinction is important when a manager reviews a delay.

findings.candidateQuote: The main driver was packing throughput between five and six
findings.explanation: "Capacity" (the ceiling on how much could be packed) is swapped for "throughput" (the rate actually achieved), which is a different technical quantity.
findings.sourceQuote: The primary cause was packing capacity between five and six

findings.candidateQuote: input an order number
findings.explanation: An "order code" is turned into an "order number", asserting a numeric identifier the source never specifies.
findings.sourceQuote: enter an order code

findings.candidateQuote: That issue triggered repeated phone calls
findings.explanation: The candidate adds that the repeated calls to the stock room were phone calls, a medium the source does not state.
findings.sourceQuote: That problem created repeated calls

findings.candidateQuote: The coordinator will review answers weekly and log the tally of respondents.
findings.explanation: The recorded quantity changes from the number of staff invited to the number who responded, which destroys the response-rate logic of the following sentence.
findings.sourceQuote: The coordinator will check responses once per week and record the number invited.

findings.candidateQuote: whether the advisory is legible
findings.explanation: Clarity (comprehensibility) of the notice is narrowed to legibility (visual readability), a different property.
findings.sourceQuote: whether the notice is clear

findings.candidateQuote: a single row can expose another guest's identity
findings.explanation: The specific disclosure of a name is broadened to disclosure of an identity.
findings.sourceQuote: one line can reveal another visitor's name

findings.candidateQuote: The paper alternative carries a minimal upfront expense and no power needs.
findings.explanation: A low direct cost (ongoing/attributable cost) is changed to a minimal upfront expense, a different cost category.
findings.sourceQuote: The paper option has a low direct cost and no battery.

findings.candidateQuote: A legible and precise real-time roster
findings.explanation: "Current" is strengthened to "real-time", asserting continuous live updating that the source does not claim, and "clear" is narrowed to "legible".
findings.sourceQuote: A clear and accurate current list
